meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成测试、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来测试或采集网页数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动控制浏览器，执行打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取文字等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要让 Claude 帮你操作网页，比如填写表单、抓取信息或测试网站时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开百度，搜索“天气”并截图。
say.note: Claude 会打开百度，输入搜索词，截图并返回。

say.text: 登录我的邮箱，检查是否有新邮件。
say.note: Claude 会打开邮箱页面，填写账号密码，登录后查看邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser interactions: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Claude to perform web tasks such as navigating sites, filling forms, extracting data, or testing web apps.

say_en.text: Open Google, search for 'weather', and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open Google, enter the query, and return a screenshot.

say_en.text: Log into my email and check for new messages.
say_en.note: Claude will open the email site, fill in credentials, and check inbox.
